item.title: Oleksandr Usyk to face former kickboxing champion Rico Verhoeven at the Egypt Pyramids
item.description: Ukranian boxer Olekansr Usyk, heavyweight champion holder of the IBF, WBA and WBC belts, but not the WBO after relinquishing it last November -Fabio Wardley inherited it- has announced his next match, his first one after defeating Daniel Dubois in July 2025. He will face the 36-year-old Dutch former kickboxing champion Rico Verhoeven at the Pyramids of Giza in Egypt, on May 23.
